upgrades.description: Each upgrade may be taken once per formation.

options.description: (0-1 in the army) Squat Grand Warlord

items.name: Living Ancestor
items.description: Füge a Living Ancestor to an Overlord Dirigible, Leviathan, Cyclops, Colossus oder Land Train hinzu.

items.name: Thunderer Transport
items.description: Ersetze two Squat Rhinos durch two Termites oder two Land Raiders.

items.name: Warrior Transport
items.description: Füge transports zur Formation, bis zu the number required to transport all infantry units in die Formation. Termites, Hellbore und Leviathan transports can not be combined with other transport options. Transports can only be taken if die gesamte Formation can be transported hinzu.
